verdict.rationale: A non-engineer could describe a task in the prompt-first flow and have an agent start immediately (superset-docs-18). They could point at UI elements in the browser preview via Design mode (superset-gh-1, superset-gh-3), turn comments on agent-created designs into updates (superset-docs-13), and ship via Create PR from the diff viewer (superset-docs-5). However, nothing shows ingesting a mockup or design file as input, and community users describe the tool as terminal-centric and developer-oriented (superset-comm-2), so a PM would likely still need engineering comfort or a review step. Missing for 10: mockup/design-file (e.g., image or Figma) to code input, evidence of non-engineer/PM workflows, independent corroboration of design-to-implementation outcomes.
